_readme: clientInfo.name → kind for the hosted /mcp usage log (src/mcp-usage-log.ts → /admin/activity mcp_usage.by_client_kind). Edit by hand: add a name to agent.names or probe.names, or a word to probe.patterns. Order of checks: agent.names (exact, case-insensitive) → probe.names (exact, case-insensitive) → probe.patterns (case-insensitive regex on the name) → unknown. agent.names holds ONLY names confirmed from the client itself or its official source; each has a `confirmed` note. Never add an agent name by guess — an unconfirmed real client stays 'unknown' until it is checked. Design: founder-ops/research/Disclosure_2026-10/INSTRUCTION-agent-usage-probe-split.md (2026-10-24).
